description.value: Coal River Services RV Park & Lodge sits at the confluence of the Coal and Liard Rivers on the Alaska Highway in the Northern Rockies of BC, roughly 30 minutes north of Liard Hot Springs. Originally built in 1949, the property offers lodge rooms, full-hookup RV sites, dry camping, and an on-site cafe famous for bison burgers. It is one of the few full-service stops for long-haul travellers on this remote stretch of the Alcan.

address.value: Mile 533 Alaska Highway, Coal River, V0C 1Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is substantial and confirms this is a real, operating business at Mile 533 Alaska Highway. The site explicitly confirms WiFi ('WIFI IS INCLUDED!') and a coin-operated laundry facility. An on-site cafe serves food including bison burgers, satisfying 'Nearby evening food.' Secure bike storage and staff bike procedures are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so both remain null. The OSM name 'Coal River RV & Lodge' differs from the current rebranded name 'Coal River Services RV Park & Lodge' shown on the website, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Coal River RV & Lodge' but the website states it has been rebranded to 'Coal River Services' / 'Coal River Services RV Park & Lodge' under new ownership. OSM name may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating, publicly accessible accommodation and services stop on a remote stretch of the Alaska Highway — a highly valuable waypoint for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The property also operates an on-site fuel station (unleaded, premium, diesel) and gift shop, and has a sister property ('Fireside Resort') 10 miles north under the same ownership.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated laundromat on site; website states 'a small coin-operated laundromat if you just can't stand one more day!'

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site cafe serving home-cooked menu items including bison burgers and bison jerky
